item.title: Philadelphia’s Franklin Field honored as America’s first stadium
item.description: Franklin Field on Penn’s campus has many claims to fame – including the Penn Relays. Many of its stadium features were ahead of its time.

item.title: Philly’s soccer summer ramping up: two new soccer fields to offer local fans their own place to play
item.description: A temporary field at City Hall and a permanent installation at Tip Top Playground in Northern Liberties are designed to build excitement for the World Cup.

item.title: Construction on Philadelphia’s Carousel House rec center begins this summer
item.description: The long-shuttered center for people with disabilities will more than double in size, with a new pool, gym and playground.

item.description: Although Philly is full of smells at all times, there’s one in particular you may have noticed lately – Bradford Pear trees.
